body: Local gates mirror CI: task lint runs gofmt -l then golangci-lint (uncapped: --max-same-issues=0 --max-issues-per-linter=0) on every go.work module; CI runs gofmt + GOWORK=off go vet, and GOWORK=off go test -race -cover for gqlkit and gqlkit-sdl, plus npm ci && npm test in gqlkit-ts. task examples:test needs mockapi running (task mockapi:run; runbay session 'gqlkit mockapi'). mockapi:generate is pinned to GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.25.5 because gqlgen breaks under Go 1.27.
